newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Comalco says expects 2nd half loss.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Comalco says expects 2nd half loss.

text.p: Comalco Ltd said on Friday it expected its operating result from business activities, before superannuation adjustment and abnormal items, for the six months to December 31, would be a loss.

"Results for the second half of the year have been adversely affected by a number of factors, mainly, lower traded metal prices and the strengthening of the Australian dollar," Comalco said in a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange.

Comalco said other factors contributing to the lower result included higher smelter costs, particularly associated with implementing the upgrade of the company's New Zealand smelter and costs of restructure at the Weipa mine.
Comalco is about 70 percent owned by the RTZ-CRA group.

In August, the company reported operating profit after tax from business activities of A$43.9 million for the six months to June 1996. For calendar 1995, Comalco's net profit after abnormals was A$232.3 million.
At 11.15 a.m. (0015 GMT), Comalco shares were just one cent firmer at A$6.20 in a much stronger market.
Comalco is about 67 percent owned by Anglo-Australian resources giant RTZ-CRA.
